title: Zuri Edge Extraction Job — cloud/device wire contract (FR-143, FR-144, ADR-059)
description: The four device-facing calls of the pull-model extraction lane and the job object they exchange. The cloud owns this shape; the zuri-edge-device repository codes against it. Every call carries `Authorization: Bearer edgk_<raw key>` (FR-144) and no session cookie. The raw key never appears in any payload defined here.

jobStatus.description: QUEUED → CLAIMED → COMPLETED | FAILED, plus CANCELLED from either non-terminal state, plus lease expiry CLAIMED → QUEUED.

job.description: The job as the device sees it. Cloud-internal columns (tenantId, resultJson, lastError beyond `error`) are not exposed on the wire.

leaseExpiresAt.description: 10 minutes after claim. A CLAIMED job past this instant returns to QUEUED and may be claimed by another device; a late complete/fail from the previous holder is refused.

error.description: The reason a FAILED job failed. Never a stack trace, host, URL or credential (SEC-025).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency token. complete/fail are idempotent per version: a retry of the same call against the same version is a no-op that returns the same job.

evidence.description: Just enough for the device to fetch and decode the bytes. Never a bucket URL, signed link or storage credential (ADR-041 D3).

candidate.description: Mirrors the zCandidate shape in src/modules/asset-management/infrastructure/openai-asset-evidence-extractor.js. Both adapters validate against one shared module, so this schema and that one must stay identical.

documentType.description: One of ASSET_EVIDENCE_DOCUMENT_TYPES in src/lib/validation/enums.js — that module is the source of truth and this list is never hand-copied into device code.

claimRequest.description: POST /api/edge/extraction-jobs/claim — the body is empty by design. Device identity and Business scope come from the credential, never from the payload; a body naming a businessId or deviceId is rejected rather than trusted.

claimResponse.description: 200 with the oldest QUEUED job of the credential's Business, now CLAIMED under a 10-minute lease. 204 with no body when nothing is queued.

completeRequest.description: POST /api/edge/extraction-jobs/{id}/complete. A candidate the shared schema rejects returns 400 and moves the job to FAILED with the validation reason.

model.description: The local model that produced the candidate, as the device reports it. Recorded on the job and in the ASSET_EVIDENCE_EXTRACTED audit event.

reason.description: Why extraction failed, in terms the console can show a Human. Must not carry a stack trace, file path, host or credential.

jobResponse.description: The 200 body of complete and fail, and of GET /api/assets/evidence/{id}/extraction-job.
